note: What the two artifacts carry from outside, and under which terms. This is the ONE place that declares it (§3, External dependency): the repository's own rule is that a third party only travels inside an artifact if its licence permits, and that whatever the licence demands travels WITH it. The artifact is a single file with no folder beside it, so the texts live inside it and come out through `at-cli license`. The SBOM (item 46) generates its licence lines from here and is never written by hand.
license_texts: Each value of `text` is a repository-relative path to a file that exists. `license` is the SPDX identifier, and each text carries a marker that proves the identifier — verified by at/tests/test_licenses.py. The five typefaces keep their files where the WebApp's own vendor manifest pins them (at/ui/webapp/vendor/), and the Caddy's and the gitleaks' are copies of the member inside each vendor's own tarball, held equal to it by the same test.

caddy.name: Caddy
caddy.note: The vendor's tarball travels byte for byte in at/vendor/caddy/, and the tarball carries its own LICENSE beside the binary; this copy is the same bytes, so the CLI can answer without unpacking a 17 MB archive.

cffi.name: cffi
cffi.note: It is MIT No Attribution, and not MIT: the text names that licence and omits the attribution clause.

gitleaks.name: gitleaks
gitleaks.note: The scanner `secret scan` walks the folder with (item 32). The vendor's tarball travels byte for byte in at/vendor/gitleaks/, and the tarball carries its own LICENSE beside the binary; this copy is the same bytes, so the CLI can answer without unpacking an 8 MB archive.

libsodium.name: libsodium
libsodium.note: The version is the one PyNaCl 1.6.2 bundles and compiles into nacl/_sodium.abi3.so — AT does not pin it and cannot read it back from the extension, so the declaration says so instead of inventing a number. The text comes from the same wheel.

pyinstaller.name: PyInstaller
pyinstaller.note: It is the bootloader that travels inside the frozen artifact, and the exception is what permits the distribution. The file carries the SPDX identifier itself.

python.name: Python
python.note: The frozen artifact carries the interpreter itself, and the PSF licence is the one it is distributed under. The patch level is not declared because it changes with every rebuild of the pinned base and the licence does not.

vue.name: Vue
vue.note: What travels is the DERIVATION — the bundle at at/ui/webapp/dist/ —, and not the package tree it was built from.
